# Zoominfo.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/zoominfo-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/zoominfo-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Zoominfo.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Zoominfo Company Data (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-zoominfo)
- **Code:** [`zoominfo.py`](zoominfo.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Company pages](results/companies.json) · [Directory pages](results/directory.json) · [FAQs data](results/faqs.json)

## What it scrapes

- Zoominfo company pages
- Zoominfo directory pages

## Functions

- `scrape_comapnies(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape company data from zoominfo company pages
- `scrape_directory(url, scrape_pagination=True)` → `List[str]`: scrape zoominfo directory pages for company page URLs
- `scrape_faqs(url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape faqs from Zoominfo company pages

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import zoominfo


async def main():
    comapnies = await zoominfo.scrape_comapnies(
        urls=[
            "https://www.zoominfo.com/c/tesla-inc/104333869",
            "https://www.zoominfo.com/c/microsoft/24904409",
        ],
    )
    directory = await zoominfo.scrape_directory(
        url="https://www.zoominfo.com/companies-search/location-usa--california--los-angeles-industry-software",
        scrape_pagination=True,
    )
    faqs = await zoominfo.scrape_faqs(url="https://www.zoominfo.com/c/tesla-inc/104333869")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/companies.json`](results/companies.json): `companyId`, `url`, `foundingYear`, `totalFundingAmount`, `isPublic`, `name`, `pageTitle`, `logo`, `numberOfEmployees`, `fullName`, `companyIds`, `doziParsedIndustries`, `address`, `fax`, `techUsed`, `techOwned`, `description`, `fundings`, `acquisitions`, `overview`, `about`, `newsFeed`, `pic`, `scoops`, `copilotContent`, `hierarchyOrgChart`, `executives`, `ceo`, `comparablyData`, `mgtl`, `recentlyHiredPeople`, `competitors`, `employeesLikelyToEngageCounter`, `topLists`, `pageViews`, `emailPatterns`, `intents`
- [`results/faqs.json`](results/faqs.json): `question`, `answer`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`zoominfo.py`](zoominfo.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"CA"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/zoominfo-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_company_scraping`, `test_directory_scraping`, `test_faq_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
